title: Rise of Islam, 610–750
dek: Of how a prophet's community in Arabia became a state, defeated two empires, and fought itself over who should rule.

panels.label: Tradition Tells It
panels.text: God revealed the Qur'an to Muhammad, and the community he founded spread the faith from Spain to Central Asia within a century.
